title: PLAICraft: Large-Scale Time-Aligned Vision-Speech-Action Dataset for Embodied AI
abstract: arXiv:2505.12707v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Advances in deep generative modeling have made it increasingly plausible to train human-level embodied agents. Yet progress has been limited by the absence of large-scale, real-time, multi-modal, and socially interactive datasets that reflect the sensory-motor complexity of natural environments. To address this, we present PLAICraft, a novel data collection platform and dataset capturing multiplayer Minecraft interactions across five time-aligned modalities: video, game output audio, microphone input audio, mouse, and keyboard actions. Each modality is logged with millisecond time precision, enabling the study of synchronous, embodied behaviour in a rich, open-ended world. The dataset comprises 5525 hours of interactive gameplay from more than 232 participants. translated_title: PLAICraft：面向具身智能的大规模时间对齐视觉-语音-动作数据集
translated_abstract: 深度生成建模的进展使得训练达到人类水平的具身智能体变得越来越可行。然而，由于缺乏能够反映自然环境感觉运动复杂性的大规模、实时、多模态且具有社交互动性的数据集，这一领域的进展一直受到限制。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PLAICraft，这是一个新颖的数据收集平台和数据集，用于捕获多人Minecraft游戏互动，涵盖五种时间对齐的模态：视频、游戏输出音频、麦克风输入音频、鼠标和键盘操作。每种模态均以毫秒级时间精度记录，从而支持在丰富、开放的世界中研究同步的具身行为。该数据集包含来自232名以上参与者的5525小时互动游戏内容。除数据集外，我们还提供了一个评估套件，用于在物体识别、空间感知、语言基础和长期记忆等能力方面对模型进行基准测试。
tldr: 该论文提出PLAICraft，一个从232名以上参与者收集的、涵盖视频、游戏音频、麦克风音频、鼠标和键盘五种毫秒级时间对齐模态的5525小时多人Minecraft交互数据集，并配套评估套件用于基准测试具身智能模型的各项能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PLAICraft, a 5525-hour multiplayer Minecraft dataset from 232+ participants capturing five millisecond-precision time-aligned modalities (video, game audio, microphone audio, mouse, and keyboard), along with an evaluation suite for benchmarking embodied AI model capabilities.
